exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: роди́ть — to give birth; рожде́ние — birth; роди́тель — parent; ро́дина — homeland, motherland, native land.
**Возрождение** — возрожде́ние: rebirth, renaissance, revival, reconstruction. Wiktionary: возроди́ть + -е́ние.

pairs: denotes a relative in the same generation as the head noun but one degree greater in separation
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: роди́мый — darling, dear; врождённый — innate, inborn, indigenous; двою́родный — denotes a relative in the same generation as the head noun but one degree greater in separation; благоро́дно — nobly, generously, selflessly.
